This market will resolve to the team defense and special teams (D/ST) unit that finishes Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring D/ST under the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 5 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more units are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 5, this market will resolve in favor of the tied unit whose team name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring D/ST in Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed unit, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 5 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).
